name: Viewtrix Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Viewtrix Technology Co., Ltd, through its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and sale of organic light-emitting diode (OLED) display driver chips and technical services in China and Hong Kong. The company offers products, such as AMOLED display driver chips for the smartphone market and Micro OLED silicon-based display driver backplane chips are designed for smart head-mounted devices used in AR applications. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
